settings.heading: Description
settings.row_content:
A firming serum built on two actives — NAD and collagen extract — in a 30 ml / 1 fl oz dropper bottle.

NAD, short for nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, is a coenzyme present in every living cell and one of the most talked-about ingredients in skincare right now. Collagen extract works at the surface, where it helps the formula spread smoothly and leaves skin feeling conditioned.

The texture is deliberately light. Two to three drops sink in within seconds and sit under moisturiser and SPF without pilling, so it slots into a routine you already have rather than replacing it.

settings.heading: Who It's For
settings.row_content:
For anyone whose main concern is how firm their skin looks, and who wants a serum that layers rather than one that takes over the routine. It suits normal, combination and dry skin.

Patch test first: a little on the inner forearm, left for 24 hours. Avoid the eye area, and stop using it if your skin becomes irritated. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or under the care of a dermatologist, check with them before adding anything new.

This is a cosmetic product. It is formulated to improve the look and feel of skin, not to treat any skin condition.

settings.heading: When do I apply it?
settings.row_content: Morning and night, on clean skin, before moisturiser. In the morning it goes under SPF; at night it is the step before your last one.

settings.heading: Can I use it with retinol or vitamin C?
settings.row_content: Most people alternate rather than stack — vitamin C in the morning, retinol at night, this serum in either. If you want all three, introduce them one at a time so you can tell what your skin is reacting to.

settings.heading: Will it pill under makeup or SPF?
settings.row_content: Not if you give it about a minute to absorb first. Pilling is almost always a layering-too-fast problem rather than a formula problem — and using more than three drops makes it likelier.

settings.heading: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.row_content: Patch test before the first full application: a little on the inner forearm, left 24 hours. Avoid the eye area, and stop if your skin becomes irritated. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding or seeing a dermatologist, check before adding anything new.

settings.heading: How do I store it?
settings.row_content: Upright, somewhere cool and dry, out of direct sunlight. The tinted glass helps keep light off the formula, but a sunny windowsill will still undo that.

settings.heading: When will my order arrive?
settings.row_content: Most orders arrive 15–30 days from the day you order, tracked the whole way. We dispatch within 1–2 business days. Full detail is in the Shipping section further up the page.

settings.heading: What if it's not right for me?
settings.row_content: Email us within 30 days of delivery. Unopened boxes are refunded in full; opened ones we can take back if the product is faulty or arrived damaged. Refunds land back on your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

settings.heading: How long does a bottle last?
settings.row_content: That depends entirely on how heavy-handed you are. At two to three drops twice a day, a 30 ml bottle is a long run — which is the argument for a dropper over a pump: you can see what you are using.

settings.heading: Two Actives, One Dropper
settings.text:
NAD — nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide — is a coenzyme found in every living cell. It has spent the last few years moving from research papers into skincare, and it is the reason this serum exists.

Alongside it, collagen extract does its work at the surface: helping the formula spread evenly and leaving skin feeling conditioned rather than stripped. Two actives, 30 ml, and nothing else asking for your attention.

settings.title: 01 — Cleanse
settings.text: Start on clean, still slightly damp skin. Everything after this lands better for it.

settings.title: 02 — Tone
settings.text: If a toner or essence is part of your routine, it goes here. If it isn't, skip straight on.

settings.title: 03 — This Serum
settings.text: Two to three drops, pressed in. Give it about a minute to disappear before anything goes on top.

settings.title: 04 — Moisturise
settings.text: Seal it in. The serum is light on purpose, so it needs a moisturiser over it rather than instead of it.

settings.title: 05 — SPF, Mornings
settings.text: The last step of any morning routine, and the one that protects the rest of the work.

settings.title: Where It Fits In Your Routine
NAD
settings.text: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a coenzyme present in every living cell — and the active this serum is named for.

settings.title: Collagen Extract
settings.text: A surface-level conditioner. It helps the serum spread evenly and leaves skin feeling soft rather than tight — it does not build collagen from the outside, and no topical does.
